note: Tickers are user-supplied at runtime as arithmetic expressions (e.g. "GDBR10 Index - GDBR2 Index"). No fixed ticker list exists in the codebase. Supported yellow keys: Index, Equity, Comdty, Corp, Govt, Curncy, Mtge, Muni, Pfd. History pulled from 2010-01-01. Field is always PX_LAST.

series.description: Any Bloomberg ticker or arithmetic expression of tickers entered by the user at runtime. Examples: 'GDBR10 Index', 'GDBR10 Index - GDBR2 Index', 'CO1 Comdty'.
